hors-connexion: Only downloaded documents can be opened.

absent.titre: This document is not on your phone
absent.texte: “{titre}” ({details}) has not been downloaded, and there is no network. It will download as soon as the network returns if you ask for it now.
absent.texte-sans-details: “{titre}” has not been downloaded, and there is no network. It will download as soon as the network returns if you ask for it now.
absent.texte-inconnu: This document has not been downloaded, and there is no network. It will open when the network returns.
absent.en-attente: The download will start when the network returns.

issue.place: The phone does not have enough space for this document. Free some in “My downloads”.
issue.panne: The download was interrupted: no partial copy was kept. Try again.
issue.refus: This document cannot be downloaded: it is no longer published, or you do not have access.

introuvable.titre: This document is not in the library
introuvable.texte: It has been withdrawn, or the address is wrong.

recherche.ambigu: These words appear several times on this page, so no single match is highlighted.
recherche.introuvable: The passage is on this page, but it cannot be highlighted.

terme.lexique: The translation and definition of this term will come with the English-French glossary.

bascule: This phone cannot display this document's pages, so it opens in “Large text”.

impossible.titre: This phone cannot display this document
impossible.texte: Its pages cannot be displayed on this phone, and the document does not offer “Large text”. You can read it on another device.

annonce.texte-agrandi: “Large text” reflows this document to the width of the screen: tap the bottom bar, then “Text”.
annonce.limite: This document can only be read as pages: “Large text” is not offered here. Your setting still applies to other documents.
